items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Are you going to continue on with this Young Tuxedo Orchestra? ... I'm going to try to hold it as long as I can

ctx.x: On his roof, yeah. On guitar or banjo? Yeah, he's on guitar. He wasn't supposed to come with the banjo, but he brought a guitar. It didn't make any difference with me as long as I had a 690, you know?
Mm-hmm. Ernie Cagnoletti, yeah. Yeah, Cagnoletti. On trumpet. Uh-huh. Yeah. Are you going to continue on with this Young Tuxedo Orchestra? You going to use that name?
Mm-hmm. I'm going to try to hold it as long as I can, Dick. Mm-hmm. I'm going to change it. I don't have no reason for changing it.
